sn21.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn21.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Theranāmako ekavihārī ceva hoti ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī || ||
sn21.10:1.3: So eko gāmam piṇḍaya pavisati || eko patikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti || || 3
sn21.10:1.4: Atha sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 4 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn21.10:1.5: Idha bhante aññataro bhikkhu Theranāmako ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavāditi || || 5
sn21.10:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhum āmantesi || ||
sn21.10:2.2: Ehi tvam bhikkhu mama vacanena Theram bhikkhum āmantehi ||
sn21.10:2.4: Evaṃ bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Thero tenupasaṅkami || || 6 Upasaṅkhamitvā āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca || ||
sn21.10:2.6: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Thero tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || || 7 Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Theram Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn21.10:2.7: Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Thera ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādīti || ||
sn21.10:2.9: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ Thera ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādīti || || 10
sn21.10:2.10: Idhāham bhante eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisāmi || eko paṭikkamāmi || eko raho nisīdāmi || eko caṅkamanaṃ adhiṭṭhāmi ||
sn21.10:2.11: Evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādīti || || 10
sn21.10:3.1: Attheso Thera ekavihāro neso natthīti vadāmi || ||
sn21.10:3.2: Api ca Thera yathā ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti
sn21.10:3.3: taṃ suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn21.10:3.5: Kathañ ca Thera ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti || ||
sn21.10:3.6: Idha Thera yaṃ atītaṃ tam pahīnaṃ || yam anāgataṃ tam paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ || paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto || ||
sn21.10:3.7: Evaṃ kho Thera ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hotīti || || 12
sn21.10:4.2: idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
